questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes the purpose of linear regression?

options.text: Estimate a causal effect between a dependent and independent variable
Predict a dependent variable using one or more independent variables

questions.explanation: Linear regression predicts the value of the dependent variable based on the values of independent variables.

questions.prompt: In the simple linear regression model y = 2 + 0.5x, what does the coefficient 0.5 represent?

options.text: The change in y for a one‑unit increase in x
The standard error of the estimate

questions.explanation: The coefficient indicates how much y changes when x increases by one unit.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT an assumption of linear regression?
questions.explanation: Multicollinearity is a potential problem but not an assumption of the model.

questions.prompt: Logistic regression is used to model which type of outcome variable?
questions.explanation: Logistic regression predicts the probability of a binary outcome.

questions.prompt: Including an interaction term between X₁ and X₂ in a regression model allows you to:

options.text: Model a non‑linear effect of X₁ alone
Capture a combined effect beyond the additive contributions of X₁ and X₂
Increase the degrees of freedom in the model

questions.explanation: An interaction term models how the effect of one predictor changes at different levels of another predictor.

questions.prompt: Which statistical test is most appropriate for comparing two nested regression models?
questions.explanation: The likelihood ratio test compares nested models by evaluating the difference in their log‑likelihoods.
